observations: All four photos show the same pedestal/standing fan from slightly different close-in angles in the same room.

Fan has a wire safety guard, three wood-grain colored plastic blades, a gold/brass colored motor cap with a small red logo that is too small/blurred to read, and a black cast-iron cross-foot base with a carrying handle built into the stand pole.
No shot shows the fan plugged in, running, oscillating, or with a visible speed control/remote.
No close-up of the power cord, plug, or any rating/label plate.
Background shows a tiled floor, a refrigerator, and an unrelated cardboard carton; no original fan packaging is shown.
No video or motion blur to indicate operation.

claims.evidence: No receipt, tag, or original packaging shown in any photo.
No photo or video shows the fan powered on, blades spinning, or oscillating.

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may run weakly/noisily
risks.proof: A short video clip of the fan plugged in, running on each speed, with audible sound
Video showing the head oscillating side to side
Video of the fan running to observe blade wobble

risks.risk: Power cord or plug damage/non-standard plug
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and full cord length

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on blades/guard under current lighting
risks.proof: Close-up photo of blade edges and guard wires in bright light

risks.risk: Base stability or cracks in the cast base not visible from above
risks.proof: Photo of the base from floor level, all sides
risks.if_unproven: priced as base condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Brand/model unidentified, affecting expected quality tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the red logo/label on the motor cap
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded unit

proof_requests: A video of the fan plugged in and running on low, medium, and high speed with oscillation engaged
A clear close-up of the brand/logo plate on the motor housing
A close-up photo of the power cord and plug
A photo of the base and blades from multiple angles in bright light
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard industrial-style pedestal fan by type, but the seller's working claim is unverified with no running footage, so it must be priced at worst case (as not confirmed working) pending the requested proof.
